videos.script: OpenAI sells two things under the agent name. AgentKit is a set of hosted products: a visual builder, an embeddable chat interface, connectors and evaluations. The Agents SDK is a Python library, and it is what this lesson runs. {{title}} The hosted half cannot run in this lab, so it is described, not shown. The library runs against the course's stand-in, unmodified, and every part of lesson seven has a name in it. {{halves}} You will look at what it sends on the wire. Strict schemas, and tool results turned into Python text rather than JSON. {{wire}} You will see its default error message hide the reason a tool failed, and fix that in one line. {{errors}} Then handoffs, agents as tools, a refund that waits for a person's approval, and a guardrail. That guardrail refuses a card number. Run in parallel with the model, it refuses too late: the number has already reached the provider. {{guardrail}} And last, sessions that remember a conversation, and traces kept on this machine instead of sent away. {{last}}
